summary: Seven-metre kerb on a junction island; too short for a van.
reasons: Only 7 m, under one van length
Wraps a tree island at a junction

drivers.seclusion: Nearest home is 24 m away but the spot is exposed in a junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the edge of a landscaped island between roads; no room to stop out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Several road arms meet here, with painted islands and moving traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen at the island; a few park on the street further west.

sun_shade: Island tree canopy shades it all day.
